messageText: OnePlus phones ship an audio debug service that any installed app can reach with zero permissions. Researcher Rasmus Moorats showed that on a OnePlus 15 an untrusted app can chain command injection in that service with a vendor HAL to get root — no user interaction, no granted permissions. He reported it to OnePlus, who replied by email on 2026-05-20. Coverage disagrees about whether a fix shipped: the researcher's page says OnePlus 15 is fixed in OxygenOS 16.0.10.500(EX01), while The Hacker News reported the flaws as unpatched. Tell the story of how a debugging leftover became a root path on a flagship phone, and what a phone owner should actually do. State only what the sources support, and say plainly where they disagree.
